name: How long does a typical home renovation project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical home renovation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a home renovation project varies greatly depending on its scope and complexity. A smaller project like a bathroom refresh might take a few weeks, while a full kitchen remodel could last 2-3 months. Larger projects, such as whole-home renovations or additions, can extend for 6 months or more. Factors like material lead times, permitting processes, and unforeseen structural issues can also affect the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule at the outset.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration depends on scope; smaller renovations take weeks, while larger ones can take several months. Material lead times and permitting also affect timelines.
